title: A debt's Retire test must fail on the commit that added the debt
why: Coordinator ruling, 15:06 CST: check_debt_retire must prove a debt's Retire test catches the defect, not only that it passes now.
note: Run each Retire test on the debt's birth commit, with head's test laid over it; it must fail. An import or collection error counts as unknown, and unknown refuses unless a Retire-run cite clears it. A missing named test file is refused. Decision debt-close-runs-retire is rewritten in place. Tightens a check; can be undone. Same lane as silent-undo-session-url-footer.
